sections.markdown:
Support Services provided to assist Military Retirees with:

* Referrals to Transition & Employment Services
* ID Cards, Pay Information or Service Records
* Federal and State Benefits
* VA Disability Compensation
* Space available Travel Information
* Legal Advice
* Advice on Death Benefits
* Will Preparation and Estate Planning
* Financial Planning
* Tax Preparation
* TRICARE
* Survivor Benefit Plans
* Opportunities
* Awards Assistance
* Casualty Assistance
* Information and Referral
* Survivor Benefit Information
* Entitlements
* Privileges
* Changes to Allotments
* Military Installations
* Consumer Protection
* Incapacitated Dependent/Adult Child
* Emergency Preparedness
* Volunteering
